name: HYDRA-UMC-DSI
build: flutter pub get && flutter build linux
notes: Native touch UI for the onboard 7" DSI touchscreen, same client role as the mobile apps but embedded on the CM5 itself. v0.1.5: a failed secure-storage delete during logout, or a partial saveToken() write (token saved, username save failed), could leave a real, orphaned token that a later loadToken() would resurrect - fixed with a plain, non-secret hydra_logged_out marker checked before secure storage is ever consulted, plus a best-effort revert of a partial write. Same fix ported to HYDRA-UMC-IOS-CONTROL. Evidence is simulator: the automated test suite runs in CI on the host against a stand-in server (the shared fake server of the SDK, a local socket server and a scripted network that goes wrong and comes back in an order drawn from a fixed seed), and the kiosk unit runs under a headless compositor in a container; nothing here has run on a Compute Module 5 with its panel.
